mapper.sql: SELECT ubu.usage_id AS benefit_history_id, approval.approval_id, approval.merchant_name, COALESCE(ubu.approved_at, approval.approved_at) AS approved_at, approval.amount AS payment_amount, CAST(CASE WHEN ubu.reward_original_unit IN ('point', 'mile') THEN ubu.reward_original_value ELSE ubu.reward_amount_krw END AS SIGNED) AS benefit_amount, CASE WHEN ubu.reward_original_unit = 'point' THEN 'POINT' WHEN ubu.reward_original_unit = 'mile' THEN 'MILEAGE' ELSE 'KRW' END AS benefit_unit, 0 AS missed_benefit_amount, CASE WHEN ubu.reward_original_unit = 'mile' THEN 'MILEAGE' WHEN ubu.reward_original_unit = 'point' THEN 'POINT' WHEN bo.reward_type = 'discount' THEN 'DISCOUNT' WHEN bo.reward_type = 'cashback' THEN 'CASHBACK' WHEN bo.reward_type = 'points' THEN 'POINT' END AS benefit_type, COALESCE(bo.offer_name, cb.title) AS benefit_title, ubu.user_card_id, CONCAT_WS(' ', COALESCE(cv.name, uc.card_name_from_codef), NULLIF(TRIM(uc.card_no), '')) AS card_name, 'APPLIED' AS calculation_status, NULL AS rejection_reason, NULL AS required_previous_spend_amount, NULL AS previous_month_spend_amount, ubu.limit_policy_id, ubu.usage_date, ubu.reward_original_value, ubu.reward_original_unit FROM user_benefit_usages ubu INNER JOIN user_cards uc ON uc.user_card_id = ubu.user_card_id INNER JOIN card_payment_approvals approval ON approval.approval_id = ubu.approval_id INNER JOIN benefit_offers bo ON bo.offer_id = ubu.offer_id INNER JOIN card_benefits cb ON cb.benefit_id = bo.benefit_id LEFT JOIN cards c ON c.card_id = uc.card_id LEFT JOIN card_content_versions cv ON cv.card_id = c.card_id AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM card_content_versions newer WHERE newer.card_id = cv.card_id AND (newer.last_seen_at > cv.last_seen_at OR (newer.last_seen_at = cv.last_seen_at AND newer.content_version_id > cv.content_version_id))) WHERE ubu.usage_status = 'confirmed' AND bo.reward_type IN ('discount', 'cashback', 'points') AND uc.user_id = #{userId} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_benefit_calculation_outcomes partial_outcome WHERE partial_outcome.approval_id = ubu.approval_id AND partial_outcome.rule_id = ubu.rule_id AND partial_outcome.outcome_status = 'partially_applied' ) UNION ALL SELECT outcome.outcome_id, approval.approval_id, approval.merchant_name, approval.approved_at, approval.amount, CAST(outcome.applied_reward_value AS SIGNED), CASE WHEN LOWER(outcome.reward_unit) = 'point' THEN 'POINT' WHEN LOWER(outcome.reward_unit) = 'mile' THEN 'MILEAGE' ELSE 'KRW' END, CAST(outcome.missed_reward_value AS SIGNED), CASE WHEN LOWER(outcome.reward_unit) = 'mile' THEN 'MILEAGE' WHEN LOWER(outcome.reward_unit) = 'point' THEN 'POINT' WHEN bo.reward_type = 'discount' THEN 'DISCOUNT' WHEN bo.reward_type = 'cashback' THEN 'CASHBACK' WHEN bo.reward_type = 'points' THEN 'POINT' END, COALESCE(bo.offer_name, cb.title), outcome.user_card_id, CONCAT_WS(' ', COALESCE(cv.name, uc.card_name_from_codef), NULLIF(TRIM(uc.card_no), '')), CASE WHEN outcome.outcome_status = 'partially_applied' THEN 'PARTIALLY_APPLIED' ELSE 'NOT_APPLIED' END, outcome.rejection_reason, CAST(rule.previous_spend_min_krw AS SIGNED), CAST(COALESCE(snapshot.current_spend_amount, 0) AS SIGNED), outcome.limit_policy_id, outcome.usage_date, NULL, NULL FROM user_benefit_calculation_outcomes outcome INNER JOIN user_cards uc ON uc.user_card_id = outcome.user_card_id INNER JOIN card_payment_approvals approval ON approval.approval_id = outcome.approval_id INNER JOIN benefit_offers bo ON bo.offer_id = outcome.offer_id INNER JOIN card_benefits cb ON cb.benefit_id = bo.benefit_id INNER JOIN benefit_rules rule ON rule.rule_id = outcome.rule_id LEFT JOIN user_card_performance_snapshots snapshot ON snapshot.user_card_id = outcome.user_card_id AND snapshot.performance_month = DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(outcome.usage_date, INTERVAL 1 MONTH), '%Y-%m') LEFT JOIN cards c ON c.card_id = uc.card_id LEFT JOIN card_content_versions cv ON cv.card_id = c.card_id AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM card_content_versions newer WHERE newer.card_id = cv.card_id AND (newer.last_seen_at > cv.last_seen_at OR (newer.last_seen_at = cv.last_seen_at AND newer.content_version_id > cv.content_version_id))) WHERE uc.user_id = #{userId} AND outcome.outcome_status IN ('not_applied', 'partially_applied') AND bo.reward_type IN ('discount', 'cashback', 'points') UNION ALL SELECT approval.approval_id, approval.approval_id, approval.merchant_name, approval.approved_at, approval.amount, 0, NULL, 0, NULL, NULL, approval.user_card_id, CONCAT_WS(' ', COALESCE(cv.name, uc.card_name_from_codef), NULLIF(TRIM(uc.card_no), '')), 'NOT_CALCULATED', NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, approval.approved_at, NULL, NULL FROM card_payment_approvals approval INNER JOIN user_cards uc ON uc.user_card_id = approval.user_card_id LEFT JOIN cards c ON c.card_id = uc.card_id LEFT JOIN card_content_versions cv ON cv.card_id = c.card_id AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM card_content_versions newer WHERE newer.card_id = cv.card_id AND (newer.last_seen_at > cv.last_seen_at OR (newer.last_seen_at = cv.last_seen_at AND newer.content_version_id > cv.content_version_id))) WHERE uc.user_id = #{userId} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_benefit_usages benefit_usage WHERE benefit_usage.approval_id = approval.approval_id AND benefit_usage.usage_status = 'confirmed' ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_benefit_calculation_outcomes outcome WHERE outcome.approval_id = approval.approval_id )

WITH history_rows AS ( SELECT history.* FROM () history WHERE history.approved_at >= #{fromUtc} AND history.approved_at < #{toUtc} AND history.user_card_id = #{userCardId} ), ranked_history AS ( SELECT history_rows.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY approval_id ORDER BY CASE calculation_status WHEN 'APPLIED' THEN 0 WHEN 'PARTIALLY_APPLIED' THEN 1 WHEN 'NOT_APPLIED' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, benefit_amount DESC, missed_benefit_amount DESC, benefit_history_id ASC) AS representative_rank FROM history_rows ), paged_approvals AS ( SELECT approval_id FROM ranked_history WHERE representative_rank = 1 AND benefit_type = #{benefitType}
ORDER BY CASE benefit_unit WHEN 'KRW' THEN 0 WHEN 'POINT' THEN 1 WHEN 'MILEAGE' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, GREATEST(benefit_amount, missed_benefit_amount) DESC, approved_at DESC, benefit_history_id DESC
ORDER BY approved_at DESC, benefit_history_id DESC
LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit} ) SELECT history_rows.* FROM history_rows INNER JOIN paged_approvals ON paged_approvals.approval_id = history_rows.approval_id

WITH history_rows AS ( SELECT history.* FROM () history WHERE history.approved_at >= #{fromUtc} AND history.approved_at < #{toUtc} AND history.user_card_id = #{userCardId} ), ranked_history AS ( SELECT history_rows.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY approval_id ORDER BY CASE calculation_status WHEN 'APPLIED' THEN 0 WHEN 'PARTIALLY_APPLIED' THEN 1 WHEN 'NOT_APPLIED' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, benefit_amount DESC, missed_benefit_amount DESC, benefit_history_id ASC) AS representative_rank FROM history_rows ) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ranked_history WHERE representative_rank = 1 AND benefit_type = #{benefitType}

SELECT CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ubu.reward_original_unit = 'point' THEN COALESCE(ubu.reward_original_value, 0) ELSE ubu.reward_amount_krw END), 0) AS SIGNED) AS total_benefit_amount, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN (ubu.reward_original_unit IS NULL OR ubu.reward_original_unit NOT IN ('point', 'mile')) AND bo.reward_type = 'discount' THEN ubu.reward_amount_krw ELSE 0 END), 0) AS SIGNED) AS discount_amount, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN (ubu.reward_original_unit IS NULL OR ubu.reward_original_unit NOT IN ('point', 'mile')) AND bo.reward_type = 'cashback' THEN ubu.reward_amount_krw ELSE 0 END), 0) AS SIGNED) AS cashback_amount, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ubu.reward_original_unit = 'point' THEN ubu.reward_original_value WHEN ubu.reward_original_unit IS NULL AND bo.reward_type = 'points' THEN ubu.reward_amount_krw ELSE 0 END), 0) AS SIGNED) AS point_amount, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ubu.reward_original_unit = 'mile' THEN ubu.reward_original_value ELSE 0 END), 0) AS SIGNED) AS mileage_amount FROM user_benefit_usages ubu INNER JOIN user_cards uc ON uc.user_card_id = ubu.user_card_id INNER JOIN card_payment_approvals approval ON approval.approval_id = ubu.approval_id INNER JOIN benefit_offers bo ON bo.offer_id = ubu.offer_id WHERE uc.user_id = #{userId} AND ubu.usage_status = 'confirmed' AND COALESCE(ubu.approved_at, approval.approved_at) >= #{fromUtc} AND COALESCE(ubu.approved_at, approval.approved_at) < #{toUtc} AND bo.reward_type IN ('discount', 'cashback', 'points') AND ubu.user_card_id = #{userCardId}

SELECT history.*, CASE WHEN history.limit_policy_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE COALESCE((SELECT SUM( CASE WHEN history.benefit_unit = 'KRW' THEN u2.reward_amount_krw ELSE COALESCE(u2.reward_original_value, 0) END) FROM user_benefit_usages u2 WHERE u2.user_card_id = history.user_card_id AND u2.limit_policy_id = history.limit_policy_id AND u2.usage_status = 'confirmed' AND DATE_FORMAT(u2.usage_date, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(history.usage_date, '%Y-%m')), 0) END AS monthly_used_amount, COALESCE((SELECT MAX(t.limit_value) FROM benefit_limit_tiers t WHERE t.limit_policy_id = history.limit_policy_id), 0) AS monthly_limit_amount, CASE WHEN history.reward_original_unit = 'mile' THEN CAST(history.reward_original_value AS SIGNED) ELSE NULL END AS earned_mileage FROM () history WHERE history.benefit_history_id = #{usageId}
